items.title: COO Q3 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues Miss on Destocking, Stock Down
items.summary: Cooper Companies reported Q3 adjusted EPS of $1.15, beating estimates by 3.6%, but revenues of $1.066 billion missed expectations by 3.0%. CooperVision faced pressure from U.S. channel inventory reductions, while CooperSurgical showed resilience with 2% revenue growth. The stock fell 15.9% after-hours as management expects continued destocking headwinds in Q4, though underlying U.S. consumption remains healthy.

items.title: The Cooper Companies Gears Up to Post Q3 Earnings: What's in Store?
items.summary: The Cooper Companies (COO) is scheduled to report fiscal Q3 2026 results on September 9, with consensus estimates suggesting modest 3.6% sales growth and 0.9% EPS growth. While CooperVision's premium lens portfolio and myopia control products are expected to drive growth, Asia Pacific headwinds and margin pressures from FX and tariffs present challenges. The stock carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) with no conclusive earnings beat predicted.

items.title: Insider Sells Over 17,000 Shares of Utility Stock, Valued at Nearly $700,000
items.summary: Jesus Soto Jr., EVP and COO of CenterPoint Energy, sold 17,075 shares worth $686,000 on August 11, 2026, through a non-discretionary transaction to cover tax withholding on vesting restricted stock units. Despite the sale, Soto retains 173,355 shares and over 146,000 RSUs vesting through 2029. CenterPoint Energy is positioned to benefit from data center growth in Texas but faces a $67 billion expansion plan that could lead to share dilution.

items.title: How to Read This Ralph Lauren Insider Filing With the Stock Up 30% This Past Year
items.summary: Ralph Lauren's COO Robert Ranftl sold 2,255 shares worth $873,204 on August 15 following restricted stock unit vesting for tax withholding purposes. The non-discretionary transaction does not reflect any change in the executive's outlook on the company. Ranftl retains 10,162 shares worth $3.85 million and received 2,904 new restricted stock units vesting in 2027. Ralph Lauren's stock has surged over 30% in the past year, with the company demonstrating strong operational performance including an expanded adjusted operating margin of 18.7% in Q1.

items.title: A Credo Insider Sold $11.3 Million in Stock After a 121% Run — Here's What Investors Should Know
items.summary: Credo Technology Group's COO Yat Tung Lam sold 50,000 shares worth $11.3 million on July 15, 2026, through a pre-planned Rule 10b5-1 trading arrangement. Despite the sale, Lam maintains over 3 million shares in the company. The article characterizes this as routine profit-taking after the stock's 121% one-year run, not a sign of concern. Credo reported strong fiscal results with revenue exceeding $1.3 billion and net income of $472.3 million, though the company faces concentration risk with 90% of revenue from its top 10 customers.

items.title: Why Newmont Stock Bumped Higher Today
items.summary: Newmont stock rose 2.5% on Tuesday following the announcement of three new C-suite executives effective July 1, 2026. The new CFO is Brian Tabolt, COO is Mark Rodgers, and CTO is David Thornton—all internal promotions. The company stated these appointments strengthen its ability to execute strategy with clarity and focus, positioning it to improve performance and deliver shareholder value.

items.title: Autonomize Strengthens Leadership Team with Industry Pioneers to Accelerate Responsible AI Adoption Across Healthcare
items.summary: Autonomize, a healthcare AI company, announced the appointment of three distinguished leaders to its Advisory Board—Dr. Brian Anderson (CEO of Coalition for Health AI), Bill Fandrich (healthcare and financial services executive), and Keith Reynolds (COO of Welldoc)—along with Mike Longacre as Head of Transformation. These appointments aim to help healthcare organizations move beyond AI pilots to enterprise-wide adoption with measurable operational, clinical, and financial impact.
